title: Fault injection: reader returns correct errors on store failures
description:
Write tests that inject storage failures into the reader command handlers: ARTICLE with SQLite returning error returns 503 (not panic); LIST ACTIVE with SQLite timeout returns 503; POST with IPFS write failure returns 441. Assert no panic and no connection drop (session continues after error response). Artifact: reader/tests/fault_store_errors.rs.

Acceptance criteria:
- All three failure cases return the correct response code
- Session continues after error
- No panics
- Test is deterministic with mock storage
